powers.name: Shock Wave
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): strike the ground: creatures within 60 ft make a DC 15 Con save or are Stunned for 1 minute.

summary: +3 warhammer that returns when thrown, stuns those it hits on a throw, and shakes the ground once a day.
text: Dwarves forged this mighty warhammer, which later went missing in White Plume Mountain's dungeon. It grants +3 to attack and damage rolls and has the Thrown property (range 20/60 feet). When a ranged attack with it hits, the target makes a Constitution saving throw against DC 15 or is Stunned until your next turn ends, and the hammer then flies back into your hand. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, you can slam it into the ground to release a shock wave: every creature you choose within 60 feet must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 15) or be Stunned for 1 minute. The hammer is sentient (Wisdom 12, Intelligence 15, Charisma 15) and loathes giants and goblinoids.
